known_concurrent_work: Parent reports V3 Blender asset generation and/or rendering likely during the queued latest gameplay suite. Exact overlap is not measured. Separate gameplay suites and art runtime suites are serialized in this worker.
interpretation: These are contextual headless CPU/logical regression measurements on shared non-reference cloud hardware. Do not claim target-platform FPS, GPU performance, an art speedup, or a reliable art CPU regression from timing differences. Functional test outcomes and unchanged gameplay content hashes are stronger evidence.
threshold_policy: No test thresholds or frozen gameplay baselines edited. Baseline failures retained and reported.
